verse.verse_1: Have We not opened your breast for you
verse.verse_2: And removed from you your burden.
verse.verse_4: And have We not raised high your fame
verse.verse_5: Verily, along with every hardship is relief,
verse.verse_6: Verily, along with every hardship is relief.
verse.verse_7: So when you have finished, devote yourself to Allah's worship.
verse.verse_8: And to your Lord turn intentions and hopes.
